svg.title: FLOW-6 synthetic contact-sheet overview; see full-frame links in Markdown
svg.desc: Inspectable graphical, synthetic-not-emulator light and dark panels for photo P0 through P5, video V0 through V4, and edge states. Safe inset placeholders are not measured.
svg.text: GRAPHICAL SPECIMEN · NOT EMULATOR · safe-inset guides are placeholders, explicitly not measured · viewer ground remains #000
L = light system theme · D = dark system theme · cyan R = fitted media rect · yellow C = crop/container · magenta = finger anchor
Edge / state companions · same ownership and cancellation contract

g.text: OWNERSHIP: bitmap/preview/HQ or poster/player/video are mutually ordered; outgoing layer survives until incoming pixels are valid and opaque.
C = black viewer container · R = fitted/cropped media rect · T = one shared fit/crop + zoom transform · URI + revision + request token gate every paint.
SAFE TOP / BOTTOM PLACEHOLDERS — NOT MEASURED. Synthetic shapes only; no Samsung, personal, browser, emulator, or runtime capture.
